role: Secular blogger, writer, and Shahbag-linked activist
contribution: Ananta Bijoy Das was a writer, banker, and contributor to the Mukto-Mona platform who participated in the secular and Shahbag-linked activist current in Bangladesh.
context: He was killed in Sylhet on 12 May 2015, amid a series of attacks on secular bloggers and writers after the 2013 Shahbag mobilization. His case sits at the intersection of press freedom, religious extremism, and public accountability.
impact: Das became part of Bangladesh's public memory of targeted violence against writers and bloggers. His story connects the Shahbag legacy to later concerns about safety, free expression, and the investigation of extremist attacks.
highlight: Mukto-Mona writer and secular activist killed in Sylhet in 2015.
seoTitle: Ananta Bijoy Das: Blogger and Shahbag-Linked Activist

shortAnswer: Ananta Bijoy Das was a Mukto-Mona writer and secular activist killed in Sylhet on 12 May 2015.
